plan.name: 30-Day Fat Loss and Muscle Retention Plan
plan.description: Three weekly full-body resistance sessions with two cardio and abs sessions, combined with two alternating nutrition plans. Goal: reduce body fat while preserving strength and muscle mass.

saturday.name: Bench Press / Chest Press Machine
saturday.notes: 3 sets. RIR 2. Rest 2-3 minutes. Use the machine if barbell pressing is uncomfortable.

saturday.name: Lat Pulldown / Pull Up
saturday.notes: RIR 1-2. Controlled full range of motion.

saturday.name: Leg Press
saturday.notes: RIR 2. Keep the lower back stable and use a pain-free range of motion.

saturday.name: Machine Shoulder Press
saturday.notes: RIR 2. Avoid painful shoulder or lower-back positioning.

saturday.name: Lateral Raise
saturday.notes: RIR 1-2. Do not swing the body.

monday.name: Chest-Supported Row
monday.notes: Use chest support to reduce lower-back loading. RIR 1-2.

monday.name: Hack Squat
monday.notes: RIR 2-3. Use only a pain-free range of motion and avoid maximal loading.

wednesday.name: Pull Up / Lat Pulldown
wednesday.notes: RIR 1-2. Use an assisted machine if necessary.

wednesday.name: Leg Press
wednesday.notes: RIR 2. Keep the lower back stable and use a pain-free range.

wednesday.name: Seated Cable Row
wednesday.notes: Do not swing or excessively flex the lower back. RIR 1-2.

thursday.name: Zone 2 Cardio
thursday.notes: 30-40 minutes. Prefer stationary bike or elliptical if more comfortable for the knee.

thursday.name: Plank
thursday.notes: Keep the body in a straight line and stop if lower-back pain occurs.

friday.name: Zone 2 Cardio
friday.notes: 25-35 minutes. Reduce toward 25-30 minutes if recovery is poor.

friday.name: Plank
friday.notes: Keep the body in a straight line and stop if lower-back pain occurs.
